title: Biomarker first-pass relation layer (disease-layer-v1)
description: Biomarker v1 as a relation layer (D-GATE-2, default-applied), not a standalone node table. Bridges disease <-> molecular entity (gene/protein/rna). Derived from high-value disease-gene/protein mappings (D-GATE-4). Aligned to FR-003 / FR-007 / SC-003 / SC-005.

biomarker_id.description: Stable biomarker identity. Derived from the bridged mapping (e.g. hash of disease+target+type) to support a future upgrade to a standalone node layer.

biomarker_type.description: Type of molecular target this biomarker bridges to.

target_id.description: Molecular target FK (gene/protein/rna id), must resolve to an existing backbone entity.

source.description: Provenance (FR-015): derived source, e.g. DisGeNET_derived / Open_Targets_derived.

evidence_class.description: D-GATE-4 default: derived mappings are bridge_only; curated biomarkers would be evidence_backed.

support.description: Optional support score from the derived mapping.
